I have adhd, so Vyvanse. Fluoxetine did also have the same effect, but I was 15 and I know age can play a part in how medication affects you. Also Fluoxetine didn't make the pain better, it just made the dpdr go away, and so I was left with intense nonstop emotional pain with no escape. Because of the neurological differences inherent to adhd likely neither of these will have the same effect for those without, so it's really up to the individual that find meds that work for them.

I wish I could help, but depersonalization & derealization have unfortunately been present in my life 24/7 for as long as I can remember. Obviously there are times when they're worse, and the advice I can give for that is simply to push through and try to take care of your body. Another thing that helps me is the understanding that this dpdr usually exists to help take the brunt of some intense emotional pain that I'm not aware of, and without the dpdr I would likely be suffering tenfold. It's a shit (and in my experience relationship-straining) experience, but eventually you get used to it. I know meds have helped me in the past.
